raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.6.5"

package:
  name: spotiflow
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/s/spotiflow/spotiflow-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 0e4a3a07c6fda64929824b53858ddc81dbd80f0f313844191515b7b3cdf621b2

build:
  skip:
    - match(python, ">=3.14")
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - spotiflow-predict = spotiflow.cli.predict:main
      - spotiflow-train = spotiflow.cli.train:main
      - spotiflow-check = spotiflow.cli.check:main

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - numpy
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools <=71.0
    - setuptools-scm >=6.2
    - wheel
    - numpy
    - pip
    - if: osx
      then:
        - llvm-openmp
  run:
    - python
    - aiohttp
    - configargparse
    - crick
    - csbdeep
    - dask-core
    - fsspec
    - h5py
    - lightning
    - networkx
    - pandas
    - pillow
    - pydash
    - scikit-image
    - scipy
    - setuptools
    - psutil
    - tensorboard
    - tifffile
    - torchvision
    - tqdm
    - typing_extensions
    - wandb !=0.23.1
    - zarr
    - ${{ pin_compatible('numpy') }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - spotiflow
      pip_check: true
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python
    script:
      - spotiflow-predict --help
      - spotiflow-train --help
      - spotiflow-check --help

about:
  summary: Spotiflow - accurate and efficient spot detection for microscopy data
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - spotiflow/lib/external/nanoflann/LICENSE.txt
  homepage: https://github.com/weigertlab/spotiflow

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - AlbertDominguez
    - imagejan
